items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: I didn't meet -- you know who I -- Baby Lovett. Baby Lovett, Julia Lee, Mary Lou Williams, all the greatest array of -- and it was the greatest array of musicians in the world.

ctx.x: Well, Jo Jones was playing then. Was he playing --
No, I didn't meet Jo back in there. I didn't meet -- you know who I -- Baby Lovett.
